title: Folic Acid Supplementation
description: Start daily 400 mcg folic acid at least 1 month prior to conception to prevent neural tube defects.

title: Preconception Blood Sugar & BP
description: Screen baseline fasting blood glucose and blood pressure to detect pre-existing hypertension or diabetes early.

title: Comprehensive Dental & Oral Health
description: Schedule an oral health checkup; periodontal infections are linked with adverse pregnancy outcomes.

title: Sperm Health & Lifestyle Prep
description: Avoid smoking, alcohol, and excessive heat exposure (hot tubs, saunas) to optimize sperm count and motility.

title: Cycle & Nutrition Tracking
description: Log menstrual cycle dates, monitor fertile window, and adopt an antioxidant-rich, balanced Mediterranean diet.

title: Ovulation & LH Peak Mapping
description: Utilize ovulation predictor kits (OPKs) or basal body temperature to identify peak fertility 24-36h before ovulation.

title: Paternal Micronutrient Optimization
description: Ensure adequate zinc, selenium, CoQ10, and vitamin C intake to support DNA integrity in sperm.

title: Shared Stress Reduction & Sleep
description: Maintain consistent 7-8 hours sleep and active stress reduction to optimize reproductive hormones.

title: ANC Visit Planner & IFA Tablets
description: Register early antenatal care visits and initiate daily Iron & Folic Acid (IFA) tablets from the second trimester.

title: Kick Counter
description: Track fetal movements starting week 28; expect at least 10 kicks or movements within a 2-hour window during restful periods.

title: TIFFA / Level-II Ultrasound Scan
description: Schedule the Target Imaging for Fetal Anomalies (TIFFA) scan between 18–20 weeks of gestation.

title: OGTT Gestational Diabetes Screen
description: Undergo oral glucose tolerance testing between weeks 24 and 28 to detect gestational diabetes early.

title: Birth Preparedness & Emergency Route
description: Prepare hospital bag, establish emergency transport route (108/hospital), and choose the accredited birthing facility.

title: Postnatal Visits & Recovery Checks
description: Complete maternal checkups within 48 hours, at 7–14 days, and at 6 weeks post-delivery for wound healing and mental health.

title: Postnatal Visits & Newborn Vaccines
description: Ensure birth-dose immunizations (BCG, OPV-0, and Hepatitis B birth dose) are administered within 24 hours.

title: Exclusive Breastfeeding & Partner Support
description: Initiate early skin-to-skin, establish latching within 1 hour of birth, and actively support feeding sessions and hydration.
